Definition: a girding on (of the ephod); hence, generally, a plating (of metal)
BiblicalUsage: 1) ephod; 1a) priestly garment, shoulder-cape or mantle, outer garment; 1a1) worn by an ordinary priest and made of white stuff; 1a2) worn by the high priest-more costly, woven of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and linen threads provided with shoulder-pieces and a breast piece of like material, ornamented with gems and gold; 1b) a metallic covering for idols, a plating over
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
